name: Folder-TS-TW

frames.best_why: All three photo cards are fanned out above the open folder, showing the reveal clearly and evenly.

tagline: A grey folder opens and three photos fan out above it.
summary: A plain grey folder sits closed until clicked, when its front flaps fold down and three tilted photo cards rise and spread out. Moving over the photos shifts them slightly.
appearance: A simple grey folder with a small tab sits alone on a black stage. Opened, three white-bordered landscape photos fan up from its mouth, each tilted at a different angle.
behaviour: Hovering nudges the closed folder up slightly. Clicking folds the front flaps down and lifts three photo cards into a fan, and clicking again drops them back and shuts the folder.
demo_content: Three alpine landscape photos inside the folder, captioned 'Trip to the Alps, 3 photos'.
search_phrases: file icon that opens to show photos
click to reveal tucked away pictures
photo stack fanning out of a sleeve
interactive case for a small gallery
small album that opens when clicked
use_when: A small set of photos or files should be tucked away and revealed on a playful click.
avoid_when: It holds at most three items and needs a click before anything becomes visible.
customise: Folder colour, scale and a list of up to three items are props; the paper sizes, fan angles and open animation are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A small folder of divs animated with CSS transitions; nothing runs until it is clicked.

a11y.note: The folder is a clickable div with no role, tab stop or key handler, so it cannot be opened from the keyboard.

issues: The folder cannot be reached or opened with a keyboard and has no accessible name.
polish_why: Neat and tactile with a satisfying fan-out; the grey body is plain and the caption sits outside.
title: Interactive File Folder
